Heights are rounded to the nearest centimetre.
The interval $10\text{--}19$ actually covers $9.5 \le h < 19.5$.
Thus, the upper class boundaries are: $19.5, 29.5, 39.5, 44.5, 49.5, 54.5, 59.5$.

Step 3: Plot and join:
Plot points at the upper boundaries, starting at $(9.5, 0)$, and join them with a smooth increasing curve.

walkthrough:
Step 1: Calculate the cumulative frequency value for the 30th percentile:
$$\text{Cumulative frequency} = 30\% \times 150 = 0.30 \times 150 = 45$$

Step 2: Read from the graph:
Locate $45$ on the vertical axis (cumulative frequency).
Move horizontally across to meet the cumulative frequency curve, then vertically down to read the height on the horizontal axis:
$$\text{30th percentile} \approx 35\text{ cm} \quad (34\text{ to } 36\text{ cm accepted})$$
